entities.name: Loïk Le Floch-Prigent
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Loïk Gérard Henri Marie Joseph Le Floch-Prigent was a French engineer and businessman. He was CEO of Elf Aquitaine between July 1989 and 1993, then president of SNCF from December 1995 to July 1996, when he was indicted in connection with the Elf affair. He is particularly known in the "Françafrique" circles.

entities.summary: Loïk Gérard Henri Marie Joseph Le Floch-Prigent was a French engineer and businessman. He was CEO of Elf Aquitaine between July 1989 and 1993, then president of SNCF from December 1995 to July 1996, when he was indicted in connection with the Elf affair. He is particularly known in the "Françafrique" circles.
